versions.name: New England Base Camp
versions.summary: The Spirit of Adventure Council's base camp and training center at Camp Sayre in the Blue Hills of Milton, Massachusetts, near Boston, running year-round weekend and public programs including a ropes course, climbing, and an indoor pool.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the community scout-camp-map project. Camp Sayre / New England Base Camp, a Spirit of Adventure Council base camp opened to the public ~2015. Coordinates geocoded from the address (US Census); elevation from the open-meteo DEM. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add. NOTE: sources describe the council as now renamed 'Greater Boston Council' (formerly Spirit of Adventure) — our councils dataset still uses spirit-of-adventure; flag a council-lineage update. Features unsurveyed.
